findings.source_quote: The article that we have chosen to share from “Bible Helps” in this issue is one of the best discourses on the subject of “faith and works” that I have ever read. ... Finally, we have The Foolishness of Preaching an evaluation regarding the basis of churches using “the altar call”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate or consistently present the English titles. Either render the publication title “Bible Helps” and the article title “The Foolishness of Preaching” fully into Chinese, or keep the original English as a parenthetical after a complete Chinese translation. Also avoid adding interpretive detail when translating ‘the altar call’; render it neutrally as “altar call” (e.g. “‘altar call’（上台祷告/呼召上台）”) rather than the more specific “呼罪悔改上台祷告” unless the English explicitly specified repentance. Example fix: “我们在本期选自《圣经助益》（Bible Helps）的一篇文章……最后，我们刊登了《讲道的愚拙》（The Foolishness of Preaching）——评估教会使用‘altar call’（上台呼召）的依据……”
findings.translation_quote: ……我们在本期选自“圣经助益”（Bible Helps）的一篇文章，是我所读过关于“信与行为”题目中最好的讲论之一。作者甚至以圣经的简单与清晰探讨了有争议的神圣拣选与预定论题目。最后，我们登载了《讲道的愚拙》（The Foolishness of Preaching）对教会使用“呼罪悔改上台祷告”（altar call）基础的评估——……

findings.suggested_fix: The translation provides a Chinese transcription plus the original English in parentheses. This is acceptable, but be consistent with punctuation and spacing for author names. If you retain the English original after the Chinese transcription, place the English exactly as the source (Curvin L. Wenger) in parentheses without extra full-width punctuation. Example fix: “Curvin L. Wenger” → “柯文·L·温格 (Curvin L. Wenger)” or simply “Curvin L. Wenger” translated as “柯文·L·温格”。
